items.exampleEn: The lake lay placidly under the morning mist.
items.exampleZh: 湖面在晨霧下平靜無波。

items.exampleEn: She waved exuberantly from the top of the hill.
items.exampleZh: 她在山頂上興高采烈地揮手。
items.glossZh: 興高采烈地；熱情洋溢地

items.exampleEn: The hotel breakfast was uninspiring: dry bread and weak coffee.
items.exampleZh: 飯店的早餐很乏味：乾麵包配淡咖啡。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather speaks animatedly whenever football comes up.
items.exampleZh: 只要一聊到足球，我爺爺就說得眉飛色舞。

items.exampleEn: The service at the restaurant was appallingly slow.
items.exampleZh: 那家餐廳的服務慢得令人傻眼。

items.exampleEn: The main bad character in the film is cold and remorseless.
items.exampleZh: 電影裡的大反派冷酷又毫無悔意。
items.glossZh: 冷酷無情的；毫不停歇的

items.exampleEn: Only an exhibitionist would sing that loudly on a crowded train.
items.exampleZh: 只有愛出風頭的人，才會在擁擠的火車上唱得那麼大聲。
items.glossZh: 愛出風頭的人；愛表現的人

items.exampleEn: The baby birds ate voraciously as soon as their mother returned.
items.exampleZh: 母鳥一回來，雛鳥就狼吞虎嚥地吃了起來。
items.glossZh: 狼吞虎嚥地；如飢似渴地

items.sentenceEn: The old bus performed appallingly on the steep mountain road.
items.sentenceZh: 那輛老公車在陡峭的山路上表現糟透了。

items.audioEn: The two friends talked animatedly about their trip all through dinner.
items.audioZh: 那兩個朋友整頓晚餐都在熱烈地聊他們的旅行。
items.questionZh: 兩位朋友吃晚餐時在做什麼？
options: Arguing about who should pay for the meal.
Checking their phones without saying a word.

items.sentenceEn: As a teenager, I read voraciously, especially science fiction.
items.sentenceZh: 我十幾歲時如飢似渴地讀書，尤其是科幻小說。

items.sentenceEn: The old dog watched the busy street placidly from the door.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻老狗在門口平靜地看著熱鬧的街道。

items.stemEn: The team's ____ performance gave the fans little reason to cheer.
items.stemZh: 球隊乏味的表現，讓球迷沒什麼理由歡呼。

items.stemEn: The kids waved ____ as the colorful parade passed by.
items.stemZh: 五彩繽紛的遊行隊伍經過時，孩子們興高采烈地揮手。

items.passageEn: Every summer, our town library runs a reading club for children. Last year, the opening speech by a local official was uninspiring, and the children kept moving around in their seats. Then the librarian, Mrs. Tan, took the microphone and talked so animatedly about monsters and pirates that everyone woke up. Over the next six weeks, even children who were not avid readers read voraciously, some finishing a book a day. One boy, a bit of an exhibitionist, insisted on reading aloud to the whole room. The heat outside was remorseless, but the library stayed cool, and parents sat placidly in a corner. On the final day, the children cheered exuberantly when they received their prizes. Only the old cooling system performed appallingly, breaking down twice.
items.passageZh: 每年夏天，我們鎮上的圖書館都會為孩子舉辦讀書會。去年，一位地方官員的開幕致詞很乏味，孩子們在座位上坐立不安。後來圖書館員 Tan 太太拿起麥克風，眉飛色舞地講起怪獸和海盜，大家一下子都醒了過來。接下來六個星期，連本來不愛看書的孩子都如飢似渴地讀書，有些人一天讀完一本。有個有點愛出風頭的男孩，堅持要對整個房間的人大聲朗讀。外面熱得毫不留情，但圖書館裡一直很涼爽，家長們安靜地坐在角落。最後一天，孩子們領到獎品時興高采烈地歡呼。只有那台老冷氣表現糟透了，壞了兩次。

questions.questionZh: 地方官員的開幕致詞怎麼樣？
最後一天孩子們做了什麼？
options: 輪流朗讀自己最喜歡的一本書
領到獎品時興奮地歡呼

items.promptZh: 他是個愛出風頭的人，總是想成為大家注意的焦點。
referenceEn: He is an exhibitionist who always wants to be the center of attention.
He is such an exhibitionist; he always wants everyone to look at him.
rubricZh: 「愛出風頭的人」用 exhibitionist，前面用 an（例如 an exhibitionist、such an exhibitionist）
「成為注意的焦點」可寫，例如 be the center of attention、wants everyone to look at him 等
說的是個性，時態配合內容（例如 is、wants）

items.instructionZh: 用 animatedly 造一個句子，描述你和別人熱烈談論某件事的情景。
referenceEn: My friends and I talked animatedly about the concert on the way home.
I chatted animatedly with my sister about our holiday plans.
rubricZh: animatedly 是副詞，常修飾 talk、chat、discuss 等動詞（例如 talked animatedly）
時態配合內容（例如 talked、chatted）
內容和自己有關（例如 I、my friends and I）
